summary: Android 8+ now draws the exact supplied composite artwork as a full-bleed adaptive background with a transparent foreground. This avoids shrinking the artwork's built-in rounded square into the safe-zone and producing a second inner frame. Existing density-specific PNGs remain unchanged for pre-API 26 devices.

checks.observation: Installed BOOHTACORD 1.0.8 (versionCode 2012) on Pixel 7 / Android 17. In the default circular launcher style, the full-color artwork has no additional visible white inner frame and is not visibly clipped beyond the expected circle mask. The app was installed in place; data was preserved.

checks.observation: The Android 17 Wallpaper & style icon customization UI was inspected. Its presented controls did not expose a distinct themed-icon toggle in this session; no launcher setting was changed. The adaptive icon currently has no monochrome layer, so themed rendering remains unverified.
